QuestInfo.name: [Hermes Cube] The Ancient Alchemist
QuestInfo.0: Hermes, the legendary alchemist of yore, came to the Maple Warrior.
QuestInfo.1:
#e#r<Hermes' Ancient Alchemy>#k#n
1) Collect 10 Hermes Cube Fragments from monsters.
2) You can create up to 10 Hermes Cubes each day.
3) Cubes can only be used on equipment Lv. 99 or lower.
4) Cubes make equipment they're used on untradable.
QuestInfo.2: You got a strange cube from Hermes.
